text:
Alex K: thinking out loud — should we add a credential provenance panel to the console homepage? small card showing: key owner, origin (ui/api/sa), most recent mint, and quota bucket. could help support + SRE when things go sideways.

Nina P: +1 on idea. main concern: telemetry cost and PII. we should avoid logging full keys and only keep opaque ids and hashes. also need guardrails so product doesn't expose cross-org info.

Samir G: agree on minimal surface. can we reuse the existing attribution model? e.g. origin: {ui, api, proxy, delegated} and project_id. that maps to current quota shards.

Lee H: UX Q — homepage real estate is tight. maybe make it a collapsible flyout on the tokens page and a small summary on homepage (e.g., "3 active keys with unusual traffic"). expands to full provenance panel.

Alex K: good call. summary on homepage, deeper panel on tokens page. panel should include a quick action: `revoke`, `rotate`, `open support ticket`.

Nina P: rollout plan: feature flag behind `console_provenance_panel`. gradual rollout per org tier. telemetry hooks: count of panel views, actions taken (revoke/rotate), and provenance lookup rate. capture only ids/hash as Samir said.

Samir G: API change — need an endpoint that returns provenance for a key. proposal: `GET /v1/keys/:id/provenance` returns `{origin, issued_by, issued_at, project_id, last_used_at, quota_bucket}`. sample: ```json
{
  "origin": "service_account",
  "issued_by": "sa-team@redwood",
  "issued_at": "2025-11-14T18:22:00Z",
  "project_id": "proj-123",
  "last_used_at": "2026-02-03T09:15:12Z",
  "quota_bucket": "burst-1"
}
```

Lee H: do we need RBAC on that endpoint? e.g., only org admins and token owners can query? otherwise customer data exposure risk.

Alex K: yes, enforce same authz rules as token view. for delegated tokens there should be extra restrictions. also audit log entry for every provenance lookup.

Ivy (deploy-bot): canary flag created: `console_provenance_panel` enabled for orgs: [alpha-corp, betaio]. deploy scheduled to next staging.

Nina P: for telemetry schema: events -> `provenance.view` (props: key_id_hash, role, org_tier), `provenance.action` (props: action=revoke|rotate|support). do not log `issued_by` email in raw telemetry.

Samir G: perf note: provenance lookups may hit metadata store. add 50ms cache per key in edge cache. fallback stale-while-revalidate to avoid latency spikes on homepage.

Lee H: Accessibility note: panel should present provenance in simple rows and provide machine-readable modal for export. also ensure features respect org privacy settings (hide project_id if redacted).

Alex K: action items: 1) Samir to draft API contract + authz matrix (ETA Tue). 2) Nina to write telemetry schema + retention proposal (ETA Wed). 3) Lee to produce wireframes for summary + panel (ETA Thu). 4) I'll own rollout canary and postmortem checklist.

Samir G: added to my board. quick question — should we surface quota usage delta in the panel or only link to billing dashboard? small delta (<5%) might be noise.

Nina P: surface quick delta (last 24h) with coloring, and "open quota details" link to billing page. that'll help ops triage fast.

Alex K: noted. if no objections I'll create PRs for API stub and feature flag tomorrow.

Lee H: no objections from me. happy to iterate on copy. :+1:

Samir G: ack.

Nina P: thanks all — tagging @security for a quick review once API contract is up.

Alex K: pinging @security in #eng-security once PRs land.

Ivy (deploy-bot): deploy pipeline started for staging. commit: `feat(console): preliminary provenance API + flag`

Alex K: thanks — closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers appear.
